title: Degree-one Lefschetz injection for vertex-induced simplex triangulations in characteristics zero and two
author: Larson, Matt; Stapledon, Alan
work: Lefschetz properties of local face modules

primary_locator.required_new_core: complete vertex-induced triangulation/special generic l.s.o.p./local face module and bilinear form, characteristic-two differential identities, Hall matching/nonzero pairing derivative and characteristic-zero rank specialization source262--555

difficulty_reason: The proof adapts differential identities to special parameter systems, constructs a Hall matching that singles out a nonzero pairing derivative, and lifts full matrix rank from characteristic two to zero. These special local-face-module constraints are substantive beyond ordinary qualification algebra.
